_readme: Curated labels for Time-app entries on the Forge maintenance block. Keyed by Time-app entry id. 'stream' must be a key in 'streams'. Entries not listed here fall back to the entry's own summary/note and the 'site' stream. 'include' lists entry ids from other projects that draw down the block. Clockify logs by time block, so a session that touched two projects is filed under its main one. This file and data/hours.json are publicly readable — keep descriptions client-safe. Each entry is rounded to the nearest quarter hour. 'adjustments' are credits (negative hours) against a project, shown as discounts.
